sentences.text: Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

Appearance:
 Shri Rakesh Kumar Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Rajesh Joshi G.A appearing on behalf of Advocate   ORDER This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 27.06.2013 in Session Case No.152/2012 by the Additional Session Judge Sardarpur, Dhar, whereby appellant/accused - Shankar has been convicted under Section 376(2)(g) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I and fine of Rs.1000/-
with default stipulation.
2.

This appeal arises out of the incident dated 12.01.2012 in which rape was committed with prosecutrix and regarding which a Crime No.161/2012 was registered at Police Station Sardarpur ,
Dhar.
3.
The PUD No.473/Warrant/2025 dated 09.06.2025 of Jail Superintendent, District Jail, Dhar mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 22.01.2020 after completing the sentence.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21338 2 CRA-1108-2016 does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
